name: Datenshi
source:
Minoru Nagata is hit by a car and regains consciousness at the edge of hell. The mysterious voice tells him to obtain the "proof of life" that an angel has if he wants to return to the Earth. However, the maze of hell is inhabited by strange monsters and and the angel would not surrender without a fight as well...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
永田稔被车撞倒后，在地狱边缘恢复了意识。神秘声音告诉他，若想回到人间，就必须取得天使拥有的“生命证明”。然而，地狱迷宫中住满了怪物，天使也不会不战而降……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
